# DNS override forwarding rules
# Format: domain.name upstream_dns[:port]
#
# These domains are resolved directly by the specified upstream DNS,
# bypassing the default Pi-hole → dnscrypt-proxy chain.
#
# Use case: internal zones served by a dedicated (e.g. corporate) DNS server.
#
# Examples:
#   corp.example.com 10.20.0.53
#   example.org      1.1.1.1

corp.example.com 10.20.0.53
